services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Shooting a film, video or TV project? NJPAC has the locations you need. Our expansive campus is a one-stop shop, with dozens of spaces ranging from grand theaters to gritty loading docks. And we have industry-leading health and safety protocols in place to protect your cast and crew. Bring your show to our stage! Producers and promoters come back to NJPAC again and again to present theater, concerts, film screenings, dance, guest speakers, and more. We look forward to re-opening our doors to audiences in the not-so-distant future, so book today. services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: Our goal is to inspire artistic and intellectual growth in both students and teachers. That’s why we’re excited to bring the arts to your classroom (or bring your classroom to us) in creative and collaborative ways. We’ll energize your students with a SchoolTime performance, teach in your classroom during an in-school residency, and help you grow in our professional development sessions. services.name: Ticket Subsidy Program
services.desc: Every year, we distribute thousands of tickets to those with limited means. Community-based 501(c)3 social service organizations in Newark and surrounding areas are eligible for $6 tickets to a wide selection of performances. To apply, fill out an application or email igonzalez@njpac.org for more

blurb: We’re NJPAC, the anchor cultural institution for the city of Newark and the state of New Jersey. As a nonprofit arts organization, we enhance and transform lives every day. We delight audiences with world-class performances, nurture students through our education programs, and engage our community with free events and festivals across the city.
